start.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Lazarus Is Sick
start.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] A messenger gasps, breathless.
"Lord, the one you love is ill."

urge_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] His Own Time
urge_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He will not be rushed.
Wait.

dismiss_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Hear Him
dismiss_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] This sickness has a purpose.
Listen.

delay.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Two Days More
delay.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He stays where he is, two days.
"It is for God's glory."

question_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] He Sees Further
question_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] His delay is not absence.
Trust him.

travel.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Let Us Go
travel.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] "Our friend Lazarus sleeps."
"I go to wake him."

stayback_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Follow Him
stayback_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Do not be left behind.
Go.

martha.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Martha Meets You
martha.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] "If you had been here, Lord,
my brother would not have died."

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Tell her to give up hope

giveup_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Hope Remains
giveup_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Death is not the end here.
Speak life.

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Find Words
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] She needs hope.
Give her his name.

mary.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Mary Falls Weeping
mary.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Mary kneels at his feet, weeping.
The crowd around her grieves.

scold_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Share the Sorrow
scold_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Even Jesus weeps.
Grieve with them.

weeps.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Jesus Wept
weeps.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He stands still, tears falling.
"See how he loved him."

pull_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Let Him Stay
pull_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He came to this place on purpose.
Lead him on.

tomb.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Take Away the Stone
tomb.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] "Take away the stone," he says.
Martha trembles. "Lord, it stinks."

leave_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Obey Him
leave_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Faith moves the stone.
Roll it.

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Believe
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] "Did I not say, believe?"
Do as he says.

call.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Lazarus, Come Out
call.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He lifts his hands and his voice.
"Lazarus, come out!"

emerge.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Unbind Him
emerge.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He steps from the tomb, alive.
"Unbind him. Let him go."
